rust_summary: reading the world camera and block collision boxes (`native_camera`, `native_block_collision`).
doc_summary: Read the most recently extracted world camera with `native_camera()` (none before a world frame): position, interpolated eye height, partial tick, yaw, pitch, final FOV, near/far planes, dimension and column-major matrices. The view is camera-relative and includes bob and spin; the projection uses reversed Z. Earlier callbacks can see the previous frame. `native_block_collision(pos)` returns block-local boxes using the empty collision context; unloaded blocks and collision errors yield no boxes. Bundles need "hooks": @API:camera_read@.
